description: Create a clean, portfolio-ready frontend UI served by FastAPI. Add static files (index.html, style.css, script.js) under src/app/static/ and mount them in main.py. The UI has a form for all 8 features, calls POST /predict_single (from FEAT-001), and displays churn probability with a visual gauge and color-coded label. Depends on FEAT-001 for the /predict_single endpoint.
steps: Step 1 — Create src/app/static/ directory and src/app/static/style.css: Responsive fintech/banking CSS theme. Color scheme: navy/dark-blue headers (#1a2332, #2d4059), clean whites (#f8f9fa, #fff) backgrounds, accent blue (#4a90d9) buttons. Red (#e74c3c) for churn risk, green (#27ae60) for safe. System font stack (Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif). Card-based form with subtle box-shadow. Two-column grid on desktop (min-width: 768px), single-column on mobile. Styled toggle switches for HasCrCard and IsActiveMember. Results section with a horizontal gauge/progress bar that fills proportionally to churn probability, color transitioning from green to red. Smooth CSS transitions on result appearance.

Step 2 — Create src/app/static/script.js: On form submit (preventDefault), collect all 8 feature values from the form inputs. POST to /predict_single as JSON with Content-Type application/json. On success, display: churn probability as percentage (e.g., '73.2%'), fill the gauge bar proportionally, apply red color class when prediction is 'Churn' and green when 'No Churn', show a label like '⚠ High Churn Risk' (red) or '✓ Low Churn Risk' (green). Add loading state on the predict button during the request. Input validation: CreditScore 300-850, Age 18-100, Tenure 0-10, NumOfProducts 1-4. Handle fetch errors gracefully with a visible error message.

Step 3 — Create src/app/static/index.html: DOCTYPE html5 page linking /static/style.css and /static/script.js. Header section with title 'Bank Customer Churn Predictor' and subtitle describing the model (Random Forest classifier trained on 10K bank records, evaluated with F1=0.54, ROC AUC=0.87). Form with labeled inputs: CreditScore (number, min=300, max=850, placeholder=650), Age (number, min=18, max=100, placeholder=35), Tenure (number, min=0, max=10, placeholder=5), Balance (number, step=0.01, placeholder=76000.00), NumOfProducts (select dropdown with options 1-4), HasCrCard (toggle switch, default 1), IsActiveMember (toggle switch, default 1), EstimatedSalary (number, step=0.01, placeholder=50000.00). Each input has a descriptive label. Predict button with class for styling. Results div (initially hidden) with probability display, gauge bar container, and prediction label. Footer with brief credit.

Step 4 — Mount static files and root route in src/app/main.py: Add imports: `from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles` and `from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse` (JSONResponse already added in FEAT-001). Add `@app.get('/')` route BEFORE the mount call that returns `FileResponse(Path(__file__).parent / 'static' / 'index.html')`. Then add `app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory=Path(__file__).parent / 'static'), name='static')`. The root route MUST come before the mount — otherwise the mount catches '/' and returns 404. Place both after all other endpoint definitions but with @app.get('/') before app.mount.
acceptance_criteria: GET / returns the index.html page with correct Content-Type text/html
The form displays all 8 feature inputs with proper labels, types, and constraints
Submitting the form with valid data calls /predict_single and displays the result
The result shows churn probability as a percentage with a visual gauge bar
The prediction label is color-coded: red for Churn, green for No Churn
The UI is responsive — usable on mobile screens
The design uses a clean fintech/banking color scheme suitable for a portfolio

findings: All 4 steps implemented and verified. GET / returns index.html (200), GET /static/style.css and /static/script.js return 200, POST /predict_single still works correctly with frontend mounted (returns churn_probability and prediction). The @app.get('/') route is defined before app.mount('/static', ...) to avoid 404. Server starts in ~4 seconds.
